topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: Ran into an old buddy today. Said he's been working at some high-flying firm, all polished and proper. But I caught him slipping, fumbling over numbers, eyes darting when he thought I wasn’t looking. I checked it out, like I always do. Turns out, the place he's been raving about? Doesn’t even exist. He’s been spinning yarns, maybe to impress or maybe just to feel a bit of the old pride. But here’s the thing: you can’t run from the truth. Sooner or later, the rain washes it all clean. I’m thinking maybe I’ll sit him down, have a little talk. See what’s really going on behind those shadows.
